_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = 'blank' because Approach B renders member login and setup partials on real pages behind public access, and the blank host gives the example its own login and account page types with no starter kit competing. namespace = what <Namespace> becomes. placeholders = <IssuerName>, the label shown in the authenticator app. assets = Approach B's files only. requires = the two pages this example seeds under site 2's root.
